subject: Order Form: patent assertion response & evidence handoff playbook
messages:
From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@acmerobotics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Robotics Legal <legal@acmerobotics.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Patent assertion - notice and immediate evidence request

Hi Ben,

I'm reaching out from Acme's legal team — we received a patent assertion that references model outputs generated by the integration with Redwood's API. Attached is the formal notice (PDF) and a short list of example prompts/outputs. Per the MSA, please confirm who at Redwood will own the response and provide the preservation and evidence-handback plan.

We need: 
- A named contact at Redwood for claims communications
- Confirmation of whether Redwood will accept defend-and-indemnify or propose a handback
- A copy of the license matrix for the deployed models and any third-party components referenced

We consider this time-sensitive; request acknowledgement within 48 hours and a proposed mutual action plan within five business days.

Thanks,
Megan Torres
Senior Counsel, Acme Robotics

Immediate asks:

Ben

Attachments: acme_claim_notice_20251118.pdf, license_matrix_export.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T11:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Patent assertion - notice and immediate evidence request

Thanks Ben — reviewed the notice. High-level thoughts: 

1) Defense posture: our standard MSA language offers customer indemnity for third-party IP claims tied to customer content/use. We can consider offer defend-and-indemnify only if the claim maps directly to customer's inputs and the customer has not modified our models or merged outputs with proprietary third-party data.

2) Evidence handoff: request a limited scope evidence bundle. We should avoid broad preservation orders. Suggested mutual action plan in Order Form: 
   - Redwood to produce the model variant + dependency matrix, runtime logs (tokenized request/response IDs), and a sanitized sample of the outputs in dispute.
   - Customer to provide the asserted patent claims, example prompts, and narrow time window.
   - Timeline: 5 business days for initial exchange; 15 business days for deeper technical review.

3) Redlines: attach a short redline for the Order Form that caps obligation to defend to situations where Redwood's service produced output that, in the ordinary course, replicates a third-party proprietary work and where customer provided the training prompt/data that caused the output. We should preserve our right to propose an escrow/insurance offset and to seek contribution from third parties where appropriate.

I'm attaching a proposed orderform redline (proposed_orderform_redline.docx). Rishi — need sign-off on carve language and any insurance/escrow triggers. Connor — confirm what logs we can provide without breaching privacy controls.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_orderform_redline.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-19T13:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Patent assertion - notice and immediate evidence request

Agree with Kim's approach. A couple of pointers: 
- Limit defend obligation to (i) customer inputs that caused the output and (ii) outputs that are not a result of model training on third-party materials for which Redwood lacks a license.
- Add a cooperation clause requiring customer to indemnify Redwood for customer-provided content that introduces third-party claims (typical back-and-forth).
- Insurance/escrow: propose a tiered cap tied to the Order Form value and an obligation that Redwood may require the customer to engage in joint defense or select counsel in case of material litigation.

Operationally: Hannah, please approve the mutual action timeline and the external communications draft. Ben, let's hold external reply until we have product confirmation of the exact model id and the sanitized evidence we can provide.

Rishi
General Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Patent assertion - notice and immediate evidence request

Megan — thanks for sending the notice and examples. We acknowledge receipt and have internal owners assigned. Proposed mutual action plan below (short form):

1) Redwood contacts: Ben Carter (AE) for commercial coordination; Hannah Schmitt (Legal Ops) for claim routing; Kimberly Park (Legal) for contract/redlines.
2) Evidence exchange: Acme to produce asserted claim language and a 72-hour window of example prompts/outputs (narrowed). Redwood to produce model variant id, dependency matrix, and a sanitized sample of the requested logs.
3) Timeline: Initial acknowledgement (this email) within 48 hours; initial evidence exchange within 5 business days (target 2025-11-25); technical deep-dive within 15 business days.

We will not agree to broad preservation at this time; the exchange will be narrowly scoped to the identifiers/time window you provide. I've opened a HubSpot note under deal HB-3481-AW and staged a Drive folder for the evidence exchange: https://drive.example.com/Acme/claim-evidence.

Please confirm Acme's acceptance of the proposed plan or suggest modifications so we can proceed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Patent assertion - notice and immediate evidence request

Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposed scope. Acme accepts the mutual action plan as outlined. We'll deliver the asserted claims and the 72-hour output window by 2025-11-24 and will upload to the Drive folder once ready.

Two quick notes: 
- Acme will expect a short redline to the Order Form that clarifies the handback boundary if Redwood cannot accept defend. Please have legal share the redline text for review during the evidence exchange window.
- We'll also need a named Redwood contact for preservation/custodian questions (a single point of contact for our outside counsel).

Megan Torres
